title: Issue and exchange payment tokens
summary: Use Tempo-native TIP-20 capabilities when building token issuance, controls, or stablecoin exchange rather than assuming ERC-20 behavior is identical.

links.description: Tempo's payment-token standard: gas payment, transfer memos, lanes, role controls, receive policies, and stablecoin DEX integration.
Create, migrate, mint, and administer a TIP-20 token. Treat mint, pause, freeze, and role authorities as production security decisions.
Integrate the protocol-level exchange for supported USD-denominated TIP-20 assets, including swaps and liquidity operations.
